milestones.title: M1 — GUI editing core
milestones.description: Labels/Instance/Frame/Skeleton/Video API the GUI edits through + SwiftUI enablers. Highest priority (north star).

milestones.title: M2 — Proofreading & merge
milestones.description: Matching/merge subsystem + LabeledFrame merge cascade for track proofreading.

milestones.title: M3 — SLP fidelity & modern formats
milestones.description: Read SLP >=1.6, fix provenance/identity round-trip, embed-on-save, sessions schema.

milestones.title: M4 — Video & relocation
milestones.description: Video model + missing-video relocation (incl. iPad bookmarks) + backend parity/perf.

milestones.title: M5 — Rendering & overlays
milestones.description: Track-color rendering, overlays, trails, render entry points, Metal path.

milestones.title: M6 — Training backend
milestones.description: numpy/tensor round-trip + training splits + geometric transforms for a sleap.swift backend.

milestones.title: M7 — Format coverage & dispatch/CLI
milestones.description: Interchange parity + new formats, unified load/save dispatch, sio CLI, umbrella API.

milestones.title: M8 — Deferred / out of scope
milestones.description: NWB, LEAP, remote/Drive loading, video-pipeline CLI. Tracked, not built now.

epics.title: E1 — Labels editing & navigation API
epics.body: Container API the SwiftUI GUI drives on every edit/navigation. The Swift `Labels` is a thin ~384-line container vs Python's 4.0k-line `labels.py`. See MEGA_PLAN.md §E1 and GAP_ANALYSIS.md §4. Sub-issues are linked below.

subissues.title: O(1) frame & track index in Labels (fix O(n) frame lookup)
subissues.desc: Add a cached (videoIndex, frameIdx)->frame index and track->instances index. Invalidate on mutation. Fixes the known O(n) `frame(for:at:)` (~1.8ms on 180k frames) and unblocks the GUI FrameIndex.
subissues.accept: lookup matches linear scan on dense fixture; index rebuilds after add/remove; multi-video isolation; lazy path uses frameMetadata() without materializing.

subissues.title: Rich Labels subscripts + find() with foreign-video resolution
subissues.desc: Overloads for int/range/[Int]/Video/(Video,Int); find(video:frameIdx:returnNew:) resolving a foreign Video object to the local one by path/content.
subissues.accept: each overload covered; foreign-video resolves; returnNew creates+registers a frame.

subissues.title: Labels.copy() deep snapshot (safe save + undo)
subissues.desc: Identity-preserving deep clone so the GUI can snapshot before save (replaces the isSaving gate) and support undo.
subissues.accept: clone !== original but structurally equal; edits to clone don't touch original; identity tables deduped; lazy is materialized or copied safely.

subissues.title: Labels.clean() + remove_predictions(clean:)
subissues.desc: clean(frames:instances:skeletons:tracks:videos:) prunes empties + unused identity objects; remove_predictions strips predicted instances.
subissues.accept: removes empty frames but PRESERVES negative frames; prunes unused skeletons/tracks/videos when asked.

subissues.title: Labels count accessors (n_user/n_pred/per-video/per-track)
subissues.desc: Add count accessors used by sidebars/QC; O(1) on lazy where possible.
subissues.accept: counts match known fixtures; lazy uses column row counts.

subissues.title: Annotation query families (get_rois/masks/bboxes/centroids/label_images)
subissues.desc: Per-frame and per-video gather of annotation families. Returns what exists today; expands as E7 datasets land.
subissues.accept: gather by frame and by video; empty when absent.

epics.title: E2 — Instance / Frame / Point accessors
epics.body: Behavioral accessors on Instance/PredictedInstance/LabeledFrame/PointsArray used by overlays, hit-testing, and the training backend. Mostly additive (S/M). See MEGA_PLAN.md §E2.

subissues.title: Instance/Frame numpy() export
subissues.desc: Array export: instance->(nNodes,2/3), invisible->NaN, predicted scores column, frame->(nInstances,nNodes,2).
subissues.accept: shapes correct; invisible→NaN; scores present; matches Python numpy() on a shared fixture.

subissues.title: Instance n_visible / is_empty / centroid_xy / bounding_box
subissues.desc: Derived geometry used by selection, overlays, QC.
subissues.accept: visibility count; centroid ignores invisible; bbox of partially-visible instance correct (2,2).

subissues.accept: empty instance all-invisible; from-array round-trips with E2.1.

epics.title: E4 — SwiftUI integration enablers
epics.body: Cross-cutting glue making the model GUI-friendly without dictating UI: coordinate conventions, version/provenance stamping, error taxonomy, progress/cancellation, observability, concurrency contract. See MEGA_PLAN.md §E4 and GAP_ANALYSIS.md §2.

subissues.title: Coordinate-convention reference + helpers
subissues.desc: Single documented invariant hub so a SwiftUI Canvas overlay agrees on y-direction and invisible sentinel. Prevents mirror/flip bugs in hit-testing.
subissues.accept: round-trip helpers; documented examples; image-space<->view-space helper tested.

subissues.title: SleapIO.version constant + provenance stamping + format introspection
subissues.desc: Public version constant; stamp provenance on save; introspect supported SLP versions/codecs.
subissues.accept: version present; stamp on save; introspection lists formats.

subissues.title: Error taxonomy + ErrorMode (strict/warn/continue)
subissues.desc: Split recoverable vs fatal; add missingVideo/skeletonMismatch/mergeConflict; ErrorMode param for load/merge.
subissues.accept: each mode's behavior on a bad frame; typed errors drive differentiated recovery.

subissues.title: Progress + cancellation contract for load/save/merge/embed
subissues.desc: AsyncStream<Progress> (or callback) + Task cancellation checks in column reader + embed loop.
subissues.accept: progress monotonic; cancel stops work promptly; no partial-write corruption on cancel.

subissues.title: Observable-friendliness + stable Identifiable/Hashable
subissues.desc: Documented change-notification signal on mutation + stable Identifiable/Hashable on identity types, without breaking @unchecked Sendable.
subissues.accept: identity hashing stable across edits; notification fires on point edit / track change / add-remove.

subissues.title: Concurrency / snapshot isolation contract
subissues.desc: Document safe handoff (use copy()); audit @unchecked Sendable; isolation domains for background export.
subissues.accept: concurrency stress test (extend StressTests) passes; documented handoff pattern.
